description:
Growing a youtube shorts channel may seem an easy thing to do, but when you're first starting out your youtube channel, you have a lot to learn. 

For the past 365 days, I've been experimenting with youtube shorts and the results have been mind-blowing! I got over 20 million views, man!

I'm sharing all the right and wrong things I did to grow my channel in that 1 year.

If you want to make viral youtube shorts and considering whether it's worth your time, I'm sure you'll learn something from this video
